boda_scratch.label: Boda scratch
lines: A boda squeezed through and took your paint with it.
Scraaape. He did not look back.
That boda had a gap in mind. The gap was your door.

rebar_scratch.label: Manhole rebar
lines: Unfinished manhole. The iron bars were designed for your door.
Rebar, sticking out, exactly at door height.

vehicle_contact.label: Vehicle contact
lines: Mirror to mirror. Everybody keeps moving.
A small kiss with the taxi.

flag_ignored.label: Ignored the flag
lines: The flag was red. Probably. It had been green a moment ago.
She waved. You were not sure which way.

obstruction.label: Hit an obstruction
lines: Kerb, kiosk, wall: something that was not road.
That was somebody's chapati stand. Almost.

altercation.label: Altercation with boda rider
lines: Ssebo! Now you have to discuss this.
The rider parks in front of you. Other riders arrive to help him think.
You are explaining yourself to nine boda riders.

open_drain.label: Open drain
lines: One wheel in the open drain. Helpful boys arrive to lift you out.
The drain had no cover. It has a wheel now.

minor_collision.label: Minor collision
lines: A proper bump. Both drivers get out to discuss whose fault it is.
Dented. The traffic behind you is very supportive.

trench.label: Road works trench
lines: Trench across the road. Too fast for the planks.
There was a sign. It was behind the trench.

hit_security.label: Hit a police or army vehicle
lines: The officer gets out slowly. That is never a good sign.
Of all the bumpers on this road, you chose that one.
Soldiers climb down from the back. You will be here a while.

convoy_violation.label: Moved during the convoy
lines: You do not move when the convoy is passing. An officer explains this.
Sirens mean stop. You are now having a long chat by the roadside.

flooded_ditch.label: Swallowed by a hidden ditch
lines: It was not one foot deep. The storm drain has your car.
The water looked shallow. It was not water all the way down.

hit_cyclist.label: Hit a bicycle
lines: Matooke everywhere, and a crowd collecting it. And you.
He was carrying forty litres of water uphill. Now look.

run_over_boda.label: Ran over a boda boda
lines: You hit a boda boda. A crowd is forming very quickly. Nobody is smiling.
The worst thing you can do on this road, and you have done it.

ratings.title: Lives in Muyenga, Works in Town

levels.name: Sunday Morning
levels.blurb: Church traffic and clear roads. Enjoy it, it will not last.

levels.name: An Ordinary Tuesday
levels.blurb: Nothing special happening. That is the problem.

levels.name: Friday Evening
levels.blurb: Everyone leaves work at once, then stops for one quick thing.

levels.name: Rainy Season
levels.blurb: Wait and lose time, or drive in and find out how deep it is.

levels.name: Back to School
levels.blurb: Every parent, every van, every mattress on every roof. The final boss.

levels.name: Boxed In: Muyenga
levels.blurb: St Barnabas closed. Kalungi impassable. A trench on Bukasa. Tank Hill three-quarters gone. Get to Kibuli.
